name: whatsapp-button
title: WhatsApp Button
description: Opens a WhatsApp chat — Atom’s contact path, never a form. Inline, pill, or icon with a sliding icon on hover.

discovery.name: WhatsApp Button
discovery.description: Opens a WhatsApp chat — Atom’s contact path, never a form. Inline, pill, or icon with a sliding icon on hover.

gotchas.note: WhatsApp Button is CSS/registry oriented for marketing embeds; prefer LinkButton or Button patterns in app React when you need full TS props.
Link must open a real wa.me / api.whatsapp.com URL; never fake the chat with javascript:void.

agent.usage: Chat on WhatsApp
